entries.issue: Wrist-tendon vibration is proprioceptive-sensitive but not afferent-pure; cutaneous and mechanical signals remain.
entries.counterexample: Tendon and bony-site stimulation can differ in skin geometry or vibration transmission even if device frequency is matched.
entries.repaired: Matched contact/acoustic control, acceleration/contact logs and an independent calibration gate are required; the note removes any pure-spindle claim.
entries.unresolved: Selective biological pathway attribution requires stronger independent evidence.

entries.issue: Contralateral pointing is a finite response with attention, motor and response-mapping components.
entries.counterexample: A localization shift may arise from left-hand pointing bias without a change in the target right-hand representation.
entries.repaired: Visible left hand, calibrated surface, baseline correction and fixed artifact rules are declared.
entries.unresolved: No direct complete-organization or no-response physiological readout is supplied.

entries.issue: Y_T probes can wash out J_T before Y_B, and body probes can alter subsequent tool performance.
entries.counterexample: A fixed Y_T-first order can make x artificially small at the later body probe.
entries.repaired: Separate matched reinduction blocks and counterbalanced readout order are mandatory; order remains in the model.
entries.unresolved: The adequacy of reinduction and the decay model require data.

entries.issue: The 30-degree common scale is physically interpretable but conventional and clipping can hide large effects.
entries.counterexample: A different preregistered scale can change a numerical dominance margin without changing raw degrees.
entries.repaired: Scale, clipping and an unclipped sensitivity analysis are frozen; any alternative is a new protocol version.
entries.unresolved: No uniquely privileged commensuration follows from C1.

entries.issue: Worst-case distribution-free simultaneous bounds are impractically wide at ordinary sample sizes.
entries.counterexample: At alpha=.05 and dominance slack .20, the conservative audit requires 1,154 complete participants.
entries.repaired: No sample size is invented; the exact bound is labeled an audit and a separate variance pilot/hierarchical model is required.
entries.unresolved: No pilot variance, raw data or practical power model exists in R161.

entries.issue: Four sessions and their distributions do not share one complete K,D,Phi,h.
entries.counterexample: Participant lineage can remain fixed while medication, learning, fatigue and neural state change across sessions.
entries.repaired: Every trial is typed separately; the profile is explicitly a cross-token scientific estimator.
entries.unresolved: A complete correspondence/measurement bridge and fixed phenomenal target remain open.

entries.issue: Confirming or excluding the body-dominant protocol predicate does not identify familiar F_O or close B_min.
entries.counterexample: The physical profile can change while ownership sentences remain fixed, or reports can change while the profile is fixed.
entries.repaired: Ownership reports are excluded from the classifier and the application bridge is explicitly retained.
entries.unresolved: Independent target semantics and reflection/sufficiency evidence are absent.

entries.issue: Component sources do not implement the full crossed protocol; exact checks are not proof-assistant or empirical validation.
entries.counterexample: A future paper may already combine these manipulations or reveal an unmodeled safety/confound issue.
entries.repaired: Source-reading scopes and method provenance are explicit; no exhaustive-priority or neural-mechanism claim is made.
entries.unresolved: A broader systematic search, ethics review, pilot and independent formal review remain.
